variants.headline: Looking back: colony openly defies its charter
variants.sub: Open defiance of the charter is taking place in {colony}.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The colony was openly defying its charter.

Working people deserve a voice in arguments about the authority under which they live. They also deserve to be kept in view when political gestures are admired. Labour should ask whose interests a position serves without inventing either the cost of defiance or a promised improvement in daily life.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We judge {target} adversely. Defiance demands a serious account of responsibility, and a bold stance should not be allowed to shelter inadequate political judgment behind the attraction of its own gesture.

variants.headline: Looking back: a public break with charter authority
variants.sub: The colony has taken an openly defiant position towards its charter.
